skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Wiping Knife
skins.content: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Wiping Knife. A style trending among the youth. Tight yet breathable, with an avant-garde design. Noted for its high-contrast colors and modular buckles, letting the wearer freely express themselves.
skins.quote: After browsing the massive CD collection, Cutter settled on a series teaching kitchen skills. She'll put in the work so that next time, she won't get banned from the kitchen again!
